newsitem.title: SPAIN: Tabacalera eyes bright future, same strategy.
newsitem.headline: Tabacalera eyes bright future, same strategy.

text.p: Spain's Tabacalera expects a bright future if it sticks to its strategy of concentrating on tobacco and distribution, chairman Cesar Alierta told shareholders on Wednesday.
"(Our) brilliant future will be achieved if the company concentrates on developing and strengthening what it really knows: tobacco and distribution," Alierta said.
The business has been structured into three areas for this purpose, he said - cigarettes, cigars and distribution - making the firm more efficient.
Tabacalera is looking at possibilities of acquisitions abroad, and the chairman highlighted "the need for internationalisation," of its activity.
In its drive for efficiency, the firm would "face the necessity of accoMmodating personnel (levels) to the necessities of competition, always via the least traumatic procedures possible."
At the end of March, Tabacalera employed 6,416 staff.
At the meeting today shareholders approved a dividend of 176 pesetas gross per share against 1996 results, up 10 percent from the year earlier.
They also approved its 1996 accounts, a year in which the firm posted net attributable profit of 11.73 billion pesetas versus 14.03 billion pesetas in 1995.
